The entire greenhouse architecture, roof grid, fern-lined benches, wide wet floor and long perspective fill almost all of this landscape photograph. Keep her chestnut bob and outfit. She holds the brass compass, but its tiny details are naturally too small to resolve at this camera distance. Wide empty foreground path. No close foreground person, no enlarged portrait, no medium view, no cropped body. Photographic, same rainy diffuse daylight.. Keep only elements visible in this framing; do not force a face into a detail or rear view.
